title: Roots Remember Footsteps: First Pressure
description: Roots Remember Footsteps unfolds across moon-grove rootlabyrinth with braided root walls and soft moss cover, pushing a one active deity Tuatha deity to prove adaptation, healing, roots, terrain control, endurance through life systems. without violating established Realm canon.
